The body, the room, and the parts of experience that do not survive language

Every other module here treats reasoning as though it happens in a person
shaped like a decision procedure. It does not. Sleep, illness, light,
noise, the people in the room and how long since eating move cognition
more than most of what the rest of this system reasons about, and none of
it reaches a decision packet unless something puts it there. So the
physical state a decision was made in is recorded beside it -- not folded
in, and explicitly not grounds to invalidate the decision. The useful
question later is not "was this a good decision" but "was this made on
four hours of sleep", and that is unanswerable if nobody captured it.

The harder half is what cannot be represented at all. A system that
models everything will translate an experience into the nearest thing its
ontology holds, and the translation reads as the experience. So the
untranslatable layer marks that something was not captured and flags the
record as unsafe to reason over. Storing an approximation is worse than
losing the experience: the paraphrase becomes the data.

A measurement never settles what an experience was like -- the
characteristic mistake of quantified-self systems, and both the report
and the measurement are kept with neither overriding. A simulation
frequency is never a real-world probability; the moment it is read as one
the sandbox has become a forecast nobody validated. The soul archive is
excluded from every optimization input, so continuity of personhood does
not depend on the measurable parts of a life.

Two smaller ones that matter. Reasoning depth scales with what being
wrong costs, because exhaustive analysis of a trivial choice spends the
attention an irreversible one needed. And the information diet is
described but never curated: curating the inputs would be shaping him
through the salience channel this system elsewhere audits.

sounded confident. Every step reads fine in a log. Three edges on the
ladder are human acts rather than inferences -- is->ought,
recommendation->choice, choice->authority -- and rung-skipping is refused
too, because without that an observation promoted straight to a
recommendation never touches PREDICTION->VALUE at all. The highest source
rung governs a derivation, so one value judgment cannot hide inside nine
facts. Delegation must originate with the founder, name the action and
expire; re-delegation may only attenuate and may not outlive its parent
-- the failure that is actually hard to see is a chain where every hop
narrows the action set while the expiry walks forward.

look identical from outside because both end in a confident answer:
a universe that was five wordings of one option, and a probability with
nothing under it. Options merge on a causal signature, so the merge count
exposes a generator producing variants. A probability requires
quantitative evidence -- a causal model says how, not how often -- and
correlated sources count once, because ten models sharing a corpus are
one observation repeated. The packet stops at RECOMMENDATION and declines
to name a winner when the remaining difference is a value choice.

meta-rational-boundary.mjs (OMEGA-03) supplies the five terminal states,
four of which are refusals. The irreducible check runs before evidence,
so abundant data cannot quietly convert a value question into a
statistical one. shouldContinueReasoning is the state most often missing
from systems like this, and its absence is why they consume the life they
were built to improve.

Forecasts are sealed over claim, probabilities and cutoff, so a
post-outcome edit cannot be scored; an outcome predating the cutoff
measures memory rather than prediction; an outcome outside the state
space is recorded as the stronger finding rather than discarded. Decision
quality is judged on what was knowable, so a lucky bad decision does not
become doctrine and an unlucky good one is not mislearned.

OMEGA-00: compile the no-drop coverage matrix from 1068 canonical concepts

The exact denominator, computed rather than asserted: 1068 concepts extracted
from ten canonical sources, 1038 rows, 30 alias merges, zero dropped.

UberBond's recurring failure has never been losing code. It has been losing
concepts -- an idea named once, donated by a superseded program, or buried in a
list of 170, quietly falling out of the project's own account of itself. So the
compiler refuses to emit a matrix whose row count does not equal its input
count, and every row's state is computed from repository evidence.

Getting the evidence honest took three corrections, each in a different
direction:

- **It indexed only src/.** Mutation War is a scripts/ module with seven suites
  and a mutation registry behind it, and it was reporting SPEC_ONLY -- an idea
  nobody had built. scripts/ and api/ are implementation surfaces and are now
  indexed.
- **Compound names matched nothing.** Canon names a concept and its qualifier in
  one string ("Mutation War and independent verification"), and requiring every
  word found nothing. Names now split on explicit conjunctions.
- **That split is also how this becomes a fiction.** "GENESIS for Life" contains
  "GENESIS", and scoring it off that would invent a Personal Civilization organ
  out of an unrelated frontier engine. So names are never split on whitespace,
  and a part-match is recorded as SUB_PHRASE and capped at PARTIAL_CURRENT --
  part of a concept existing is a different fact from the concept existing.

Verified in both directions: Mutation War, Capability Genome and Wallbreaker
find their evidence; every "for Life" variant correctly stays SPEC_ONLY.

The matcher's conservative bias is recorded in the artifact itself, because
SPEC_ONLY must not be read as a finding. "Event Horizon capital allocation"
reads SPEC_ONLY while src/event-horizon.mjs exists. An under-claimed row is a
lead for a human; an over-claimed one is a lie that compounds.

OMEGA-MATRIX-01 had to be re-anchored. The drop-detection check is a backstop no
current input can reach, so mutating it survived every test -- unfalsifiable
rather than untested. It stays, with a note saying why it carries no mutation,
and the mutation moved to the merge branch that actually decides whether a
second naming is remembered.
